notes: Account background: EU-headquartered mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary product: user behavior analytics + in-app assistant for product teams.
Primary ask: Replace in-house embeddings + cheap chat layer with managed inference that guarantees EU data residency and predictable latency (<200ms for EU chat median).
Initial approach: start with Redwood Hosted API in eu-west for quick POC, then evaluate Dedicated reserved capacity in EU for production (data residency + SLA).

Model preferences: leaning open models (Llama-3 / Mistral family) but willing to use Redwood-curated variants. Interested in quantized variants to reduce cost. Careful about hallucination for summarization flow.
Traffic profile: peak 40-60 chat reqs/s across EU; bursts to 120 reqs/s during product launches. Embeddings batch jobs nightly (2M tokens/day).
Latency/throughput targets: median <200ms token-serving for chat EU region; 95th <600ms. Embedding latency less critical but throughput must sustain analytics pipelines overnight.
Cost sensitivity: moderate. Willing to commit to Dedicated if unit costs drop 30%+ vs hosted. Wants clear math on batching, KV cache benefits.
Security/compliance: must support SSO/SAML, SOC2, audit logs retention 2 years, and EU-only data residency for customer data and backups (DPA required). KMS integration mandatory for Dedicated.

Routing/fallbacks: require multi-region read-only failover for NA customers (low % of traffic). Need policy: prefer eu-primary, fallback to eu-dedicated or eu-hosted-compatible only; no automatic cross-border backups without consent.
Quote from CTO on call: 'We need latency guarantees for EU users — willing to pay for capacity, but legal needs to see concrete DPA + residency for backups.'
Internal champions: Head of Product (Ana Kovac) and Platform Lead (Marc Dupont). Procurement is cautious; legal wants vendor DPA before procurement approval.
Recent ask: detailed throughput/latency benchmarks for requested model variants in eu-west + expected token costs per 1M tokens under Hosted vs Dedicated (with 12-month commit).
POC plan: 4-week POC. Week1: Hosted API integration + smoke tests. Week2: load testing and latency SLO validation. Week3: pilot users in 2 EU countries. Week4: decision + pricing negotiation.
